part.text:
Everything's in place, `dist/` and `node_modules/` are gitignored. All tests pass. I did not commit anything since the user didn't ask for it.

**Built:** a static site generator CLI (`ssg build --content <dir> --output <dir>`) in TypeScript (strict mode) using `marked` + `gray-matter`, with a hand-rolled `---`-delimited YAML block parser (simple `key: value` splitter, supports bracketed/comma lists and quoted strings) merged on top of gray-matter's output. It recursively finds `.md` files, renders each to its own HTML page plus an `index.html` listing all pages sorted by date. 14 Jest tests cover frontmatter parsing, rendering, the generator (including nested dirs and sorting), and the CLI itself; I also did a manual end-to-end run of the built binary to confirm real output.
